description: A man takes two supplements to get his daily iron and calcium requirements. A pill of supplement A has 5 units of iron and 10 units of calcium. A pill of supplement B contains 4 units of iron and 15 units of calcium.  The man needs a minimum of 40 units of iron and 50 units of calcium per day. If the cost per pill of supplement A is $2 and the cost per pill of supplement B is  $3, how many of each should he buy to minimize costs?

NutrientContent.definition: Amount of nutrient j per pill of supplement i

MinRequirement.definition: Minimum required units of nutrient j

CostPerPill.definition: Cost per pill of supplement i

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of purchasing supplements A and B while meeting the daily iron and calcium requirements"
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(CostPerPill[i] * NumPills[i] for i in range(NumSupplements)), GRB.MINIMIZE)

constraints.description: 5 × (number of pills of supplement A) + 4 × (number of pills of supplement B) must be at least 40 (iron requirement)
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(NutrientContent[i][0] * NumPills[i] for i in range(NumSupplements)) 
    >= MinRequirement[0]
)

constraints.description: Number of pills of supplement A must be greater than or equal to 0
Number of pills of supplement B must be greater than or equal to 0

NumPills.definition: Number of pills taken of each supplement type
